reviews.reason: Explicitly approved schema-and-consumer work can be one task. Clarify authorization rather than infer that schema expansion is allowed whenever convenient.

The detector explicitly treats every commit as whole-scope completion. Separate a validated interim checkpoint from delivery acceptance; the user has independently authorized incremental commits in this task.
The conjunction accepts search without the approval demanded by Fix when no convention fits. New identifiers following a convention are not new conventions.

The introductory subjects already say user decision and cross-activity routing. Preserve them explicitly in Detect to prevent verb-only matching; local technique judgment is not intrinsically prohibited.
The detector includes numbered criteria and iteration but the remedy always chooses Protocol. Reusable criteria and structural session loops need their existing owners.

Pinned implementation confirms that authored Markdown headings become parsed inputs[] and ancestor inputs compose into the effective signature. Familiar names are not proof of universal runtime supply. Static provenance acceptance and actual value availability remain distinct.
reviews.proposed_fix_override: AP-16: An externally supplied value belongs to the effective input signature or an explicitly documented delivery contract applicable to that technique. Author declarations as ### <id> under the owning ## Inputs; inputs[] is the parsed representation. Reuse inherited declarations. AP-62: distinguish effective I/O and evidenced runtime context before checking local producer/read order. Mark only an actual local producer with the local-binding sigil; an absent external supplier needs a declared contract, not a fictional local. Qualify target_path and branch_name by their actual supplying contract. See the pinned implementation check for precise replacement blocks and supported limits.

reviews.reason: Same-file or same-bucket tests miss incompatible inherited obligations that reach one reader. Group names settle the conflict only when they actually define disjoint applicability or precedence.

Necessary isolated-reader copies are explicitly protected from hygiene findings by worker-rule-reach and flagged by no-duplicated-guidance. This is a bounded opposing audit prescription, not proof the entire corpus is unsatisfiable.
The activity-file Rules repair is categorically prohibited by no-activity-prose-rules. Distinguish a workflow audience bucket from an activity definition.
The local-rule detectors and remedies overlap. Consolidation can remove duplicate findings while retaining note formatting at its separate owner.

The existing Fix already protects facts lost on deletion. Clarify the applicability/interpretation/failure-recognition test so rationale cleanup preserves those facts; avoid treating every explanatory clause as necessary.
This is an optional product-scope choice, not a contradiction and not authorization to mutate a user environment. No maintenance exception is adopted in this review.
